R3.title: «Վերանորոգում · Առաջ → Հետո» v3 — unrenovated spaces BECOME renovated: geometry-matched RAW → PROGRESS → FINISHED photo sequences (no line art)
R3.honesty: After the intro every photo is licensed stock (Pexels / Unsplash, marketing/instagram/assets/stock/CREDITS.md), NOT a GARON project. Each sequence is built from DIFFERENT real rooms whose geometry was matched (04-R3-prep.py) to illustrate the stages of a renovation; only s3_prog → s3_fin is one real room photographed at two stages (same Pexels series). Nothing says or implies «մեր աշխատանքը / our project»; the caption (03-copy.json R3, hy/ru/en) says the footage is illustrative stock showing renovation stages.
R3.replaced_v2: v2 («Գծագիր → Իրականություն»: line drawings generated from finished interiors) replaced on owner feedback 2026-11-12: «You didn't pick good photos. Work longer, but make it NOT line drawings — an UNRENOVATED part of a house that BECOMES renovated.»
R3.replaced_v1: v1 (procedural flat SVG room, built stage by stage) replaced on owner feedback 2026-11-12: «Make it REALISTIC» + «fast, quick cuts, several shots».
R3.renderer: marketing/instagram/2026-11-12-reel-3-renovation/04-R3-renderer.js — usage: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node 04-R3-renderer.js <repo_root> <out_dir> [all|cover|0,30,...]. Step 1 (automatic if <out_dir>/_prep/manifest.json is missing): python3 04-R3-prep.py <repo_root> <out_dir>/_prep → one aligned, graded image per shot <id>.jpg in window-local coordinates. Writes R3_%03d.png, R3_cover.png, measure.json; f0–179 are delegated to tools/render_l02_frames.js. If code and spec disagree, the spec wins.

prep.usage: python3 04-R3-prep.py <repo_root> <out_dir> [ids] [--debug]  (--debug: <out_dir>/_dbg/<a>__<b>.jpg = A | 50 % blend | edge overlay (red A, blue B, black = coincident) | B, for checking the alignment of consecutive stages)
prep.note: every shot image covers its `extent` (window units; window = 940×1253) at 1.1 px per unit; the renderer places it at extent[0..1] and scales it to the extent size. Mapping = similarity (uniform scale + translation) from landmark pairs to the sequence anchor (a 3:4 crop). Prep refuses nothing silently: it prints coverage (must be 1.0) and max on-screen upscale (must be ≤ 1.35) per shot.

R3.needs_shoot_note: v3 needs no shoot (illustrative stock). Recommended for a later honest «GARON Առաջ → Հետո» reel: see shoot_list_future.

shoot_list_future.what: the same format with GARON's OWN renovation: film every room from ONE fixed tripod mark at each stage (before demolition, after demolition, rough plaster/plumbing, floor laid, finished + furnished)
shoot_list_future.phone: 4K 30 fps, vertical 9:16, 1× lens (24–26 mm equiv.), locked exposure/white balance (AE/AF lock), HDR off, grid on
per_room: mark the tripod position on the floor (tape + photo of the mark), height 1.45 m, level, same heading — note it in the site log
10 s static clip + 1 still at each stage from the mark
3 detail clips 5 s each: window, floor at the skirting, a light source / socket
one slow 6 s push-in from the mark (no gimbal swings)
shoot_list_future.privacy: no people/faces, no client documents, no street numbers through windows

easings.note: CSS cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) control points; evaluate exactly like CSS (solve x(t)=p by Newton/bisection, return y(t)).

R3.keyframes_rule: Every animated property is a list of keys [frame, value, easing]. Before the first key: first value; after the last key: last value. Between key k and k+1: v = v_k + (v_k+1 − v_k) · E((f − f_k)/(f_k+1 − f_k)), E = easing NAMED IN KEY k (see `easings`). "hold" = keep v_k until f_k+1 then jump. Vector values ([x,y] or {x,y,w,h}) interpolate component-wise.

window.note: = R2 window. All shot geometry (crops, line drawings, dims, bloom points) is in WINDOW-LOCAL coordinates: fractions of 940×1253 or px.

vlines.note: v2: = L02 v4 keys (fade-in 176–196 starts inside the borrowed intro; continuous across f179→f180)

gold_piece.shape_note: the GOLD path of the logo relative to its anchor (330, 132.5) in mark units
gold_piece.g: px per unit: g = 1.6 for f ≤ e; g = 1.6·32^E((f−e)/12) for e < f ≤ e+12, E = inOutCubic (→ 51.2: the polygon covers the window from e+12)

grain.css: full-frame div, background = 256x256 grayscale noise tile (deterministic PRNG seed 7, values 128±40), mix-blend-mode overlay, opacity 0.05; background-position shifts every 2 frames by ((37·k) mod 256, (91·k) mod 256), k = floor(f/2)

photo_rules.selection: checked one by one (2026-11-12): no people, no faces, no logos/watermarks, no readable brand names in the used crops. Rejected/unused: 15798780 (RAW, but the only matching finished frames need >1.35× upscale), 3615721 (paint-can and bucket labels, blue branded bag), 9908376 (branded AC unit + printed boxes), 7031403 (commercial lobby, purple LED, off-style), kitchen / bathroom / living-beige (no geometry match for the RAW frames — kept for later).
photo_rules.grade: per stage (prep grade): RAW = lifted shadows, slightly desaturated dust; PROGRESS = clean neutral white; FINISHED = warm (+2.5 b*), +12 % saturation — the colour itself tells the stage. Owner preference: bright, colourful processed images.
photo_rules.upscale: max on-screen upscale vs source pixels ≤ 1.35 for every shot incl. camera (prep manifest `max_screen_upscale`); actual max 1.32 (s3_fin at f450).
photo_rules.blur: s3_raw: the paper notice taped inside the middle window is blurred (blur_rects_frac).
photo_rules.mirror: s2_prog (8469938) is mirrored so its doorway sits where the raw opening of s2_raw is; it shows no text.

R3.cameras_note: camera wrapper transform = translate(tx + 2.0·sin(f/41), ty + 1.6·sin(f/53+1)) scale(s), transform-origin = window centre (470, 626.5). Shots of one sequence share one camera → stages stay aligned during transitions. Visible window units: u = (x_screen − 470 − tx)/s + 470.

transitions.cut: hard cut at frames[0] (on the beat)
transitions.slider: R2 gold slider language: the incoming shot is clipped to the right of a vertical divider that travels from the right window edge to the left (x = 940·(1 − E(t)), E = `ease`); 2 px #c9a96a divider with shadow + the R2 handle (56 px, ring #c9a96a, chevrons #856727) riding at y 1016; handle opacity 0→1 in the first 3 frames, 1→0 in the last 4; a small light leak follows the divider
transitions.light: dissolve through light: u = (f − frames[0])/(frames[1] − frames[0]); a warm-white veil rgba(255,246,232) inside the window = 0.58·sin(π·u)^1.4; the incoming shot fades in UNDER the veil peak only: opacity = inOutSine(clamp((u − 0.3)/0.4)) (no long double exposure); particles (see `particles`) are born at frames[0]−2 and settle until frames[1]+22 (they read as dust in the light while the room changes)
transitions.material: masked material wipe in window coordinates: the FLOOR reveals from the bottom (edge y from 1253 → line_frac·1253, soft 46 px) and the WALLS from the top (edge y from 0 → line_frac·1253) at the same time ("walls":"top"), or the walls cross-fade over walls_frames ("walls":"fade"); a 1.5 px gold level line (#c9a96a, 0.9) rides on each moving edge and fades at the end; ease inOutCubic

plaster.note: falling plaster dust that slows and settles (y = y0 + v0·(1−e^(−drag·t))/drag), larger flakes soft (blurred disc)

motes.note: golden light motes floating in the window light

R3.shots_rules: Each shot is visible inside frames (inclusive). An incoming transition (shot.in) runs over in.frames while the previous shot stays visible below. Detail inserts (d*) are 1 beat. The hero stays to 779 under the end veil. pair_raw is shown only left of the final slider divider.
R3.labels_note: section «ՎԵՐԱՆՈՐՈԳՈՒՄ» (Montserrat/Noto Sans Armenian 500 18 px, 0.24em, uppercase, rgba(23,25,28,.62)) + stage word «Առաջ» / «Ընթացք» / «Հետո» (Noto Serif Armenian 500 40 px #856727), right-aligned to x 1010, y 270/294 — same slots as R2/v2. The stage word changes half-way through each transition (5-frame rise); during the final slider it follows the divider (Առաջ when p > 0.5) and reads «Առաջ | Հետո» during the split hold.

indicator.what: = R2 indicator (x 874–1010, y 352): stage fill Առաջ 1/3, Ընթացք 2/3, Հետո 1; final slider: fill = 1/3 + 2/3·(1 − p)

slider.p_note: p ∈ [0,1], divider x (window-local) = 940·p. LEFT of the divider = Առաջ (pair_raw, same camera), right = Հետո (hero). p = 0: finished.

R3.alt_hy: Կարճ տեսանյութ բաց ֆոնի վրա։ Ճարտարապետական ցանցի վրա կառուցվում է GARON նշանը, և նրա ոսկեգույն մասը բացում է պատուհանը։ Երեք արագ պատմություն՝ «Առաջ → Ընթացք → Հետո». աղյուսե պատով և նոր պատուհանով քանդված սենյակը դառնում է սվաղված սենյակ՝ կաղնե հատակով, հետո՝ լուսավոր ննջասենյակ. աղյուսե պատերի միջև բացվածքը ծեփի փոշու միջով դառնում է սպիտակ դռան բացվածք, հետո՝ քարե պատ բազմոցով. հին աղյուսե պատը խողովակների մնացորդներով դառնում է նոր պատ նոր խողովակներով, ներքևից բացվում է կաղնե հատակը։ Արագ դետալներ՝ պատուհան, բույս, հատակ։ Վերջում տաք հյուրասենյակ, և ոսկեգույն սահիչը համեմատում է այն չվերանորոգված սենյակի հետ։ Լուսանկարները նկարազարդող stock են (Pexels, Unsplash), ոչ GARON-ի նախագծեր։ Վերջին կադրում՝ լոգոն, «Լողավազաններ · Տներ · Վերանորոգում» և garon.am։
